research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Examines how Wright was convicted of rape/murder despite multiple alibis, later exonerated through DNA after 25 years. Available via CBS/Paramount+.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While searches didn't confirm a 48 Hours episode titled "Guilt by Association" about Anthony Wright, his case fits the description in the list. Wright was convicted based on a coerced confession for a 1991 rape/murder in Philadelphia and served nearly 25 years before DNA proved his innocence, leading to acquittal at a 2016 retrial. The case gained further notoriety when detectives involved faced perjury charges related to their testimony at the retrial.
